# Libertty ▸ Theme Editor: a color changed shows in every window at once;
# Cancel puts the theme back; Save and Use writes a theme file of your own
# and makes it the theme. Runs with a config folder of its own (@CFG@):
# theme = probe-theme (background #112233).
expect-background:#112233
theme-editor:open
theme-editor:set:background=#203040
expect-background:#203040
theme-editor:cancel
expect-background:#112233
# Saved: the file, the config's theme, the windows.
theme-editor:open
theme-editor:set:background=#304050
theme-editor:set:1=#ff0000
theme-editor:name:Probe Made
theme-editor:save
wait:0.6
expect-background:#304050
type:grep -c 'background = #304050' '@CFG@/themes/Probe Made' && grep '^theme' @CFG@/config
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:theme = Probe Made
